description: React component for displaying and interacting with mock tests, including loading test data, starting a test, submitting attempts, and showing status messages.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the list of mock tests from the API and updates component state.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Sets the selected mock test to start.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits the current mock test attempt and displays success or error toast.
